findings.claim: The descendant chain from Glasgow-3970 to Glasgow-1143 remains unproved, while the downstream Glasgow-1143 and Wilson-78088 family is strongly supported.
findings.confidence: Mixed: upstream unknown; downstream strongly supported
findings.reasoning: No inspected record names a child of Robert Glaskow of Larne. Deed, will and equity transcriptions create a separate well-supported family island beginning at Kilwaughter in 1738.

objective: Prove descendants of Robert Glaskow of Larne without converting tree topology into evidence.
